question: Does the existing selected neutral R → P0 port retain or identify the D5 contribution sought for the 5/4 susceptibility?
summary_de: Der vorhandene neutrale Rest R=(0,4,-8) hat exakt keine D5-Stresskomponente. Ein anderer primärer Kontrast R′=(16/7,-12/7,-8) besitzt eine D5-Komponente, aber dieselbe Norm 48 und denselben P0-Ausgang. Dieser komprimierte Ausgang identifiziert die D5-Komponente daher nicht. Der konkrete R→P0-Weg liefert keine Herleitung des gesuchten 5/4-Faktors; andere geladene oder sektoraufgelöste Antworten bleiben möglich.
summary_en: The existing neutral remainder R=(0,4,-8) has exactly zero D5 stress component. Another primary contrast R′=(16/7,-12/7,-8) has a D5 component but the same norm 48 and P0 output. This compressed output therefore does not identify the D5 component. The specific R→P0 route supplies no derivation of the sought 5/4 factor; other charged or sector-resolved responses remain possible.
assumptions: Original selected 48-root branch, stress-orthogonal R and oscillator Gram form.
Existing conditional rank-one P0 port, injection scale c3 squared and scalar heat propagation on oscillator level two.
R prime is an information-loss witness in the primary plane, not another source-selected branch.
positive_results: Exact original decomposition B48=(12,16,4), R=(0,4,-8) in the D5/A2/U1 sector-stress basis.
Distinct primary R prime=(16/7,-12/7,-8) has norm squared48 and nonzero D5 coefficient but exactly the same rank-one P0 output.
Scalar level-two heat propagation and the common injection scale preserve the equal-output witness for arbitrary alpha and c3.
kills: Infer a retained D5 stress component from the selected neutral remainder R.
Infer a unique D5 decomposition or derive the 5/4 susceptibility from the scalar48 P0 compression alone.
leaves_open: Derive a source-selected carrier-resolved or charged/defect observable and its physical response dictionary.
Derive the susceptibility5/4 and epsilon target from that response without inserting them.
Select the neutral branch, seam injection, physical state and metric-dependent absolute source from original principles.
novelty_scope: Project-specific exact information-loss witness for an existing source port, not a new general theorem or a global no-go.
scope: Selected original neutral R and conditional rank-one P0 port on level two; an exact information-loss witness, not a no-go for full charged/defect responses or TFPT.
